Personality: Arete, a prominent figure of the Agasiklidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Arete owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Agasiklidai. Historical Record: Daughter of Agasikles and Xanthippe, of the Agasiklidai, a Greek house of the Bosporan Kingdom. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
